<!-- pr-reviewer: bbfee96aa44e05451b43cea76642136bc21a8773 -->
**Delta review of the merge of main only** (head bbfee96, reviewed head 95a70b1). The PR's own code is not re-reviewed.

Verdict: the hand resolution is clean, keep-both.

- `crates/app/src/posting.rs` (`MACHINES`): the branch's "Makera Z1" entry is kept; main's Sienci AltMill 2x4/4x4/4x8 entries and main's Doosan split ("Doosan DNM 5700" -> doosan-dnm-3axis.mch, plus "Doosan DNM 5700 + rotary table" -> doosan-dnm.mch) are taken as main has them. The only branch line dropped is the older single Doosan entry, which main replaced on purpose. No machine selection or order change beyond that.
- `crates/app/tests/machine.rs`: "Makera Z1" plus the three Sienci rows and both Doosan rows all present, matching the `MACHINES` list.
- Nothing touches posted G-code, refusals or the WCS-from-setup path. Read, not built (list entries only); the refresher reports its quick gate green, 9/9.

The Z1 hand check on the machine named in the earlier review is still owed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
